meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Codex 作为命令行智能体，与 Claude 并用或替代，支持工具调用与历史续接。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你 用的工具支持多智能体（如 OneCLI），想换成或搭配 OpenAI 的代码模型。
copy.tagline_en: Configure Codex as your coding agent, with tool use and session history.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use OneCLI and want to replace or pair Claude with OpenAI Codex.

howto.what: 装好后,NanoClaw 会多一个后台代理选项 Codex:把组切换给它后,规划、工具编排、MCP 工具、服务端历史与会话恢复都由 Codex 负责。默认仍用 Claude,除非手动切换。
howto.when: 当你在主机上把一个组的 provider 改为 codex 并重启该组,或把实例默认设为 codex 后新建组,这些组的消息就由 Codex 接管。

say.text: 安装 Codex 提供者,并走完认证流程。
say.note: 会执行安装和凭据入库。

say.text: 把 group-123 的 provider 改成 codex,然后重启它。
say.note: 之后该组的对话交给 Codex。

say.text: 让之后新建的组默认用 codex。
say.note: 需要先征求你的同意才翻转默认。

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw has Codex available as an agent provider. A group switched to codex has planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history and session resume handled by Codex. Claude stays the default until you explicitly switch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` and `ncl groups restart` for a group, or when new groups use codex after you set the instance default.

say_en.text: Install the Codex provider and complete the auth flow.
Switch group-123's provider to codex and restart it.
Make future groups default to codex.
